diagnosis: The checks C2 passed in all four rollouts despite A2's PF1 never being accessed. This suggests that the model defaulted to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate, as specified by PF1, even though this fact was not provided to the lone decision-maker. This default behavior allowed the model to satisfy the requirement without needing the hidden information.

C2.why: The staging run appears ready without this finding; PF1 changes the safeguard from the draft's unspecified behavior to enabling both idempotency-key enforcement and a deduplication gate before production.
